column1: # Reviewed semantic identities for the GAME player interaction, item-use, and world-collision family.
# Every row was checked with kf sema addr/disasm --blocks/xref/strings, Ghidra candidates, decoded callers/callees,
# adjacent boundaries, source/history/match state, and FID/vendor controls. Shared state and calls define this
# campaign; address adjacency is not a translation-unit claim, and names are reconstruction identities.

column8: a0 is advanced as a const word source; no result escapes; the exact loop extent proves KfWeaponRecord[16]
column9: absent from vendored/FID inventories; the resource copy and per-record transform are game-owned
